newsitem.title: USA: O'GARA TO MERGE WITH KROLL ASSOCIATES.
newsitem.headline: O'GARA TO MERGE WITH KROLL ASSOCIATES.

text.p: Security services firm O'Gara Co said Thursday it would merge with Kroll Associates in a stock swap transaction.
In a press statement O'Gara said that under terms of the deal it will acquire all of Kroll's stock and options for 6.75 million of its shares, which closed Thursday at 12-3/8.
Kroll provides intelligence, investigative, and risk management services, while O'Gara provides security services, security hardware products and security systems integration activities.
The new company -- to called Kroll-O'Gara -- would have had about $188 million in revenue for the fiscal year ended December 31, 1996.

After the merger, which requires shareholder approval from both companies, Kroll chairman Jules Kroll will become chairman and chief executive of the new company, while Thomas O'Gara will become vice chairman and Bill O'Gara president and chief operating officer.
O'Gara said it expects the deal to be accounted as a pooling of interests.
Officials from O'Gara were not immediately available to comment.
